_about: Epsom's track middle lines measured by eye off the owner's Google Maps satellite screenshot (18 Nov 2026, 1170 x 2532 px, north up; the screenshot itself is not kept in the repo). Pixels, x right, y down. Read on a 50 px grid at 3x zoom; the track is the bright mown band, between the grey path on its inside and the public roads outside it. 'scale' (metres per pixel) and 'post' are fitted, not measured: see layout.py SAT_* for why.
source: Google Maps satellite view, owner's screenshot IMG_1167.png

straightLine.note: the home straight's middle: straight, about 15 degrees south of east from the post

features.rightBend: the Derby course bends right (east to east-south-east) between about x 250 and 450, then bears gently left to the south-east corner
features.sixChute: a straight chute carrying the east leg on south from about (1027, 1300): light rails visible at x 1005-1010, y 1290-1450
features.sevenChute: a short green wedge leaving the south-east corner's outside to the south-south-west, about (850-900, 1440-1500)
features.fiveFurlong: the straight course runs on east-south-east past where Tattenham Corner meets it, across the public road at about x 1080 and off the screenshot's edge
features.insideRoad: a tarmac road follows the inside of Tattenham Corner (seen in the video with crowds along it)

1m4f10y: on the east-running stretch, just before the right-hand bend (as the diagram: the start, then right, then left)
1m2f18y: about the end of the right-hand bend
1m114y: the south arm's southernmost stretch (the diagram's high point of the top arm)
7f: at the mouth of the 7f chute
6f: in the 6f chute, south of the fork
